models_evaluated: RSNA 2022 Cervical Spine Fracture Detection Challenge winning deep learning algorithm (CNN)

links.outcome: Local sensitivity, specificity, F1, AUC of AI on external trauma center CT scans versus competition data
links.effect: Sensitivity 86% and specificity 70% in external validation versus 85% and 94% in competition group; sensitivity held but specificity dropped.
links.quote: Sensitivity and specificity were 86% and 70% in the external validation group and 85% and 94% in the competition group, respectively.

links.outcome: Difference between development and external validation population characteristics and effect on performance
links.effect: External validation set comprised older patients than the competition set (53.5 ± 21.8 vs 58 ± 22.0 years; P < .05); specificity fell from 94% to 70%.
links.quote: The external validation data set comprised older patients in comparison to the competition set (53.5 ± 21.8 years versus 58 ± 22.0, respectively; P < .05).

screen.reason: The study conducts an external validation of an existing challenge-winning deep learning model on a clinical dataset from a trauma center, evaluating diagnostic performance and generalizability.
